lines.text: After entering the land, the worshiper brings firstfruits in a basket to the priest and declares he has entered the land.
The priest sets the basket before the altar, and the worshiper says his father was a wandering Moabite.
The Egyptians afflicted Israel, the LORD heard their voice, and He brought them out and gave them a land flowing with milk and honey.
In the fifth year, the year of the tithe, the tenth of produce goes to the Levite, foreigner, fatherless, and widow.
The LORD has proclaimed Israel His treasured possession and will set them high above all the nations He has made.
